## Description

A filamentous green alga of ~40 × 28 µm cells with two star-shaped chloroplasts (each with a
pyrenoid) and the nucleus between them. It lives in ponds and on wet soil and moss.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `moss` (weight 0.25), `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.07); 2 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A [filament](../../mechanics/stalks-and-colonies.md#filaments) with the `stellate_plastids` style and cyclosis.

## Literature

- Transeau E.N. (1951) *The Zygnemataceae*.

## Not implemented yet

## Unique and shared mechanics

Shares filaments with *Spirogyra*, *Mougeotia*, *Oedogonium* and *Ulothrix*.
